scope: Independent R5 editorial attribution verification; no manuscript edits or scientific/numerical rerun.

model_record.evidence: Root-confirmed successful spawn arguments, communicated 2026-11-14. Configuration is recorded from spawn arguments; backend model identity was not independently measured.

result: Central retained attributions are supported at the access levels recorded. One relevant historical identity-conditions study was found and is recommended as the single bibliography addition.

records.capability: Adaptive nonlinear interpolation networks whose learning reduces to linear equations.
records.relevance: Supports the separation of nonlinear basis responses from linear output estimation.

records.access: Publisher full text, selected sections inspected
records.capability: Coefficient-L2 regularization and k-means RBF models admit data-dependent kernel interpretations; weighted k-means error analysis includes quantization loss.
records.relevance: Closest existing theoretical analysis of the coefficient-regularized RBF family.
records.decision: Retain. Distinguish the coefficient penalty from the Gaussian RKHS penalty. The weighted k-means qualification in R4 is accurate.

records.access: Publisher indexed abstract/preview; institutional metadata. Full body not independently accessed.
records.capability: Compares normalized and standard RBF networks; describes normalized hidden responses as a Voronoi-like partition whose output values are supplied by output weights.
records.relevance: Predecessor for geometric interpretations of normalized Gaussian responses.
records.decision: Retain Voronoi-like description. Simplify table object to normalized Gaussian RBF responses; learned-center details and one-node dominance are not independently verified from primary body in this pass. Positive common normalization preserving argmax is direct algebra.

records.authors: Adityanarayanan Radhakrishnan; Mikhail Belkin; Caroline Uhler
records.access: Published institutional full text, Theorem 3 and associated explanation inspected
records.location: Article p. 4, Theorem 3 and following kernel-ratio explanation
records.capability: Characterizes a 1-NN regime for infinitely wide/deep networks under activation moment conditions; explicitly compares its dominance proof with the narrow Gaussian limit.
records.relevance: Establishes the nearest-neighbour limiting mechanism used to orient the finite-bandwidth question.
records.decision: Retain “a 1-NN regime”; do not say all infinitely wide/deep networks implement 1-NN.

records.authors: Sascha Saralajew; Ashish Rana; Thomas Villmann; Ammar Shaker
records.location: Section 2, “On the interpretability of deep PBNs”; Section 3
records.capability: Identifies mismatch between nearest centroids and weighted class scores; extends probabilistic Classification-by-Components to address interpretation issues and derives robustness guarantees.
records.relevance: Direct support for why a nearest prototype need not determine the unconstrained weighted readout.
records.decision: Retain. Attribute readout mismatch specifically to this analysis, rather than making every study in the theme jointly establish it.

records.access: Publisher indexed abstract, introduction and section previews; full body not accessed
records.location: Abstract; introduction contribution list; conclusion preview
records.capability: Uses the existing ±ED-WTA framework to interpret softmax output neurons through positive/negative prototypes and training-sample contributions; reports disproportionate influence from near-boundary samples.
records.relevance: Complementary sample-level explanation of learned softmax decisions.
records.decision: Retain as reported finding, with softmax target explicit. It does not establish the present ridge-region theorem.

records.authors: Atsushi Shibagaki; Yoshiki Suzuki; Masayuki Karasuyama; Ichiro Takeuchi
records.location: Section 2 binary linear setup; Section 3.1 score bounds; Section 4 interval approximation guarantee
records.capability: Bounds validation scores at one regularization value from an approximate solution at another, then bounds cross-validation error over a regularization interval.
records.relevance: Direct predecessor for reasoning over parameter ranges and query-score enclosures.
records.decision: Retain current scoped description: regularized binary classification and fixed inputs.

records.authors: Eugene Ndiaye; Tam Le; Olivier Fercoq; Joseph Salmon; Ichiro Takeuchi
records.location: Solution-path framework and Section 4, Lemma 4 (Gap safe region)
records.capability: Builds approximate convex regularization paths with complexity guarantees and bounds validation error using solution regions defined by duality gaps.
records.relevance: Parameter-path certification with a fixed design matrix; connects solution enclosures to validation predictions.
records.decision: Retain. The fixed design versus bandwidth-varying features distinction is accurate.

records.authors: Amir Noorizadegan; Sifan Wang; Leevan Ling
records.access: Author full text, Sections 3–4 inspected; publisher indexed abstract and author publication metadata
records.location: Sections 3–4; first-layer feature blocks, rank/conditioning diagnostics, practical scale interval
records.capability: Analyzes the first Gaussian-KAN feature layer and conditioning to propose a practical scale interval; evaluates function approximation and physics-informed tasks.
records.relevance: Supporting context for the geometric/numerical role of Gaussian scale.
records.decision: Retain current restrained claims. Use practical design rule if mentioning the interval. Identity is real and matches the three named authors.

records.access: Author full text, Section 2.1 inspected; publisher indexed abstract and institutional publication record
records.location: Section 2.1, Eqs. (35)–(43), especially constant reproduction Eq. (41)
records.capability: Normalizes Gaussian edge features over fixed centers to form a partition of unity; reproduces constants exactly and evaluates reduced scale sensitivity.
records.decision: Retain. Do not imply its edge normalization is the same certificate construction. Publisher and institutional records establish online publication in October 2026.

records.authors: Danny D’Agostino; Ilija Ilievski; Christine Annette Shoemaker
records.access: Author full text, Sections 2–3.1 inspected; arXiv journal-reference metadata
records.capability: Learns a Gaussian precision matrix and extracts active-subspace and feature-importance information from its spectrum.
records.relevance: A distinct explanation based on learned feature geometry.

records.access: Publisher full text, abstract and introduction inspected
records.capability: Initializes deep RBF networks by k-means/covariance estimation and uses partially connected Mahalanobis-distance calculations.
records.relevance: Learning representation geometry is a complementary setting to fixed centers and scalar width.

records.capability: Certifies input-perturbation robustness for nearest-prototype classifiers with specified decision and threat metrics.
records.relevance: Clarifies that the object varied in a certificate must be stated.

records.authors: Elan Rosenfeld; Ezra Winston; Pradeep Ravikumar; Zico Kolter
records.capability: Uses randomized smoothing to certify predictions against adversarial training-label changes.
records.relevance: Contrasting varying object: training labels rather than hyperparameters.

records.access: Author course notes, relevant section inspected
records.capability: States the exact inverse-times-residual solution-error identity and norm bound.
records.relevance: Source for the standard linear-algebra step supporting the manuscript-specific residual construction.
records.decision: Retain as course notes, not a scientific novelty comparator.

records.authors: Sargur N. Srihari; Lee J. White; Thomas Snabb
records.access: Published institutional full text, all 11 pages available; Sections 2–4 inspected
records.location: pp. 22–23 setup; Section 3 geometric identity conditions; Section 4 identity algorithm
records.capability: Compares nearest-sample decisions with class sums of exponential potentials and derives symmetry/weighting conditions and an identity algorithm for binary decision surfaces.
records.relevance: Direct conceptual predecessor for finite-scale equivalence of nearest and aggregate radial decisions.
records.decision: Recommend this single addition. Its target is input-space decision-surface identity with prescribed potentials; the manuscript fixes a query and varies bandwidth/penalty after ridge fitting.

editorial_actions: Use Que to establish the actual regularized model, Saralajew for weighted-readout mismatch, and Bugmann/Radhakrishnan for geometric/limiting mechanisms.
Add Srihari1979 as a finite-scale identity predecessor; do not claim nearest-neighbour/radial-decision equivalence is a newly posed general question.
Treat Fazaeli as complementary softmax sample-influence explanation; Gaussian-KAN sources as scale/representation context.
Explain Shibagaki and Ndiaye together as path bounds, then introduce bandwidth-varying design plus the fixed nearest-label reference.
Replace repeated present-study gap endings with one connected final synthesis.

unresolved.issue: Full primary body not independently accessed; restrict to publisher-preview-supported Voronoi interpretation and classification comparison.

excluded_expansion: The related 1980 Srihari/Snabb/White article was identified at publisher-abstract level. It is not recommended as a second addition because one accessible full-text predecessor suffices.
